palette.role: Evergreen foliage and summer scent in warm, sheltered sectors only.

attachment.supportNeeds: Warm sheltered microclimate; slender timber members or cables to twine.
attachment.caveat: Twining is the primary mechanism (RHS: needs supporting wires or trellis). Aerial rootlets on damp rough surfaces are reported without citation and cannot be ruled out; if real, it could cling to timber as well as twine.

monthsUK.basis: Months read from the RHS season wording (spring = Mar-May, summer = Jun-Aug, autumn = Sep-Nov, winter = Dec-Feb; early, mid and late are the first, second and third month).

flowering.display: Very fragrant white flowers; glossy dark leaves often bronze-red in winter.

site.aspect: Warm full sun or partial shade, ideally south or west facing, sheltered from cold winds.
site.soil: Fertile, well-drained; dislikes waterlogging and summer drought.

management.notes: Train and tie on to secondary wire, manage spread, inspect for leaf scorch and dieback after winter.

hazards: The whole plant is poisonous (Flora of China); white latex when cut.
